title: page-lab/profile@1
description: One browser profile page-lab can drive. The plugin ships path-free defaults only (daily, lab, lab-diag in scripts/lib/profiles.mjs); an operator overlay at ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/page-lab/profiles.json — a JSON array of these objects — replaces a default by name or adds one. A Nix fleet writes that file with Home Manager; no repo holds a per-person path.
$comment: Same keyword surface as pick-envelope.schema.json, so lib/envelope.mjs#validate enforces it: type, properties, required, additionalProperties, items, uniqueItems, enum, const, pattern, minLength, allOf, if/then, not. Deliberately no $ref/$defs. A dedicated profile has NO userDataDir field on purpose: its dir is derived as ${XDG_STATE_HOME:-~/.local/state}/page-lab/profiles/<name> by the launcher, so neither a model nor an overlay can point a dedicated browser at the daily profile.

schema.description: Schema identity AND version; never widened in place.

name.description: daily, lab, lab-diag, or an operator-added name. Hex-encoded into the CLI daemon's session id, so it stays short and ASCII.

mode.description: attach = drive the operator's running browser (scripts/chrome-devtools-attach.sh, unchanged). dedicated = page-lab launches its own browser on its own dir, over a pipe.

userDataDir.description: attach only: the daily browser's profile dir, absolute. Forbidden on dedicated — that dir is derived, never supplied.

headless.description: dedicated only; defaults to true. The handoff relaunch flips it to false for one headed session and changes nothing else.

source.description: env = read PAGE_LAB_CHROME at launch. nix = a /nix/store path the fleet pinned. path = any other absolute path.

path.description: Absolute path to the browser executable. Required unless source is env.

allowedOrigins.description: dedicated only: each origin becomes one --allowedUrlPattern=<origin>/* (URL Pattern syntax; an omitted port matches only the scheme default). Empty or absent = no network allowlist.

allOf.$comment: dedicated: the dir is derived, never supplied.
attach: the browser is the operator's; page-lab neither launches it headless nor restricts its network.
